design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use NAEP plausible values or any PV-based achievement outcome, focusing instead on process profiles.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in its analysis of the NAEP data.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not report any validation strategy beyond internal validation methods such as proof-of-concept illustration.
